text_en: After these things and these acts of faithfulness, King Sennacherib of Assyria came and invaded Judah and encamped against the fortified cities, thinking to win them for himself.
text_cn: 这些忠贞之事作完之后，亚述王散乃黑黎布来进攻犹大，包围一切坚城，企图攻破，占为己有。

text_en: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come and intended to fight against Jerusalem,
text_cn: 希则克雅见散乃黑黎布前来，决意要进攻耶路撒冷，

text_en: he planned with his officers and his warriors to stop the flow of the springs that were outside the city; and they helped him.
text_cn: 便与自己的将领和勇士商议，将城外的水泉堵塞；他们都赞成；

text_en: A great many people were gathered, and they stopped all the springs and the wadi that flowed through the land, saying, “Why should the Assyrian kings come and find water in abundance? ”
text_cn: 于是召集许多人，将水泉和通过田间的水渠都堵塞，说：“为什么让亚述王来，得到这样多的水！”

text_en: Hezekiah set to work resolutely and built up the entire wall that was broken down, and raised towers on it, and outside it he built another wall; he also strengthened the Millo in the city of David, and made weapons and shields in abundance.
text_cn: 希则克雅遂加强防御工事，重修所有破裂的城墙，上面建上城楼，城外又筑了一道墙，加强达味城的米罗，制造了许多箭矢（shǐ）和盾牌。

text_en: He appointed combat commanders over the people, and gathered them together to him in the square at the gate of the city and spoke encouragingly to them, saying,
text_cn: 然后派了将官率领军民，将他们集合到城门广场他自己面前，鼓励他们说：

text_en: “Be strong and of good courage. Do not be afraid or dismayed before the king of Assyria and all the horde that is with him; for there is one greater with us than with him.
text_cn: 你们应该勇敢大胆，不要害怕，不要因亚述王和他所统领的大军而胆怯，因为那与我们同在的比与他同在的，更有能力。

text_en: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the Lord our God, to help us and to fight our battles. ” The people were encouraged by the words of King Hezekiah of Judah.
text_cn: 那与他同在的只是血肉的手臂，那与我们同在的却是天主，我们的天主，他必要协助我们，为我们作战。”众人都因犹大王希则克雅这番话而得到鼓励。

text_en: After this, while King Sennacherib of Assyria was at Lachish with all his forces, he sent his servants to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah of Judah and to all the people of Judah that were in Jerusalem, saying,
text_cn: 此后，亚述王散乃黑黎布派自己的臣仆到耶路撒冷来，──他本人偕全军驻在拉基士──向犹大王希则克雅，和在耶路撒冷所有的犹大人说：

text_en: “Thus says King Sennacherib of Assyria: On what are you relying, that you undergo the siege of Jerusalem?
text_cn: “亚述王散乃黑黎布这样说：你们在耶路撒冷受困，还依靠什么呢？

text_en: Is not Hezekiah misleading you, handing you over to die by famine and by thirst, when he tells you, ‘The Lord our God will save us from the hand of the king of Assyria’?
text_cn: 希则克雅曾对你们说过：雅威我们的天主必要救我们脱离亚述王的手，这岂不是诱惑你们，使你们饿死渴死吗？

text_en: Was it not this same Hezekiah who took away his high places and his altars and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, ‘Before one altar you shall worship, and upon it you shall make your offerings’?
text_cn: 希则克雅岂不是将高丘和香坛推翻，且吩咐犹大和耶路撒冷人说：你们应在一个坛前朝拜，单在这上面焚香吗？

text_en: Do you not know what I and my ancestors have done to all the peoples of other lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands at all able to save their lands out of my hand?
text_cn: 难道你们不知道我与我的祖先，对各列邦民族所作的事吗？列邦各地的神，是否曾能拯救自己的国土，脱离我的手？

text_en: Who among all the gods of those nations that my ancestors utterly destroyed was able to save his people from my hand, that your God should be able to save you from my hand?
text_cn: 我祖先所消灭的那些邦国的诸神中，有哪一个曾能够拯救自己的百姓，脱离我的手？难道你们的神就能拯救你们脱离我的手吗？

text_en: Now therefore do not let Hezekiah deceive you or mislead you in this fashion, and do not believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom has been able to save his people from my hand or from the hand of my ancestors. How much less will your God save you out of my hand! ”
text_cn: 所以现在，不要让希则克雅这样欺骗你们，迷惑你们；你们也不要相信他，因为任何一个国家，一个民族的神，都不能拯救自己的百姓，脱离我的手，和我祖先的手；何况你们的神？他更不能救你们脱离我的手！”

text_en: His servants said still more against the Lord God and against his servant Hezekiah.
text_cn: 散乃黑黎布的臣仆，还说了许多毁谤上主天主，和他仆人希则克雅的话。

text_en: He also wrote letters to throw contempt on the Lord the God of Israel and to speak against him, saying, “Just as the gods of the nations in other lands did not rescue their people from my hands, so the God of Hezekiah will not rescue his people from my hand. ”
text_cn: 散乃黑黎布也写信嘲笑上主以色列的天主，侮辱他说：“就如列邦民族的神没有拯救自己的百姓脱离我的手，同样希则克雅的神也不能救自己的百姓脱离我的手。”

text_en: They shouted it with a loud voice in the language of Judah to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten and terrify them, in order that they might take the city.
text_cn: 随后，他们用犹大方言向耶路撒冷城墙上的军民呼喊，想惊吓他们，令他们恐惧，以便夺取京城。

text_en: They spoke of the God of Jerusalem as if he were like the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of human hands.
text_cn: 他们论及耶路撒冷的天主，好似论及列邦民族的神一样，当作人手的造物。

text_en: Then King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz prayed because of this and cried to heaven.
text_cn: 希则克雅王与阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚先知为此向天祈求呼吁。

text_en: And the Lord sent an angel who cut off all the mighty warriors and commanders and officers in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned in disgrace to his own land. When he came into the house of his god, some of his own sons struck him down there with the sword.
text_cn: 上主便派一位天使进入亚述王的营中，将所有的兵士、将军和统帅，予以歼灭，使亚述王含羞回了本国。当他进入自己的神庙时，为他亲生的儿子用剑所杀。

text_en: So the Lord saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of King Sennacherib of Assyria and from the hand of all his enemies; he gave them rest on every side.
text_cn: 这样，上主救了希则克雅和耶路撒冷的居民，脱离了亚述王散乃黑黎布和所有敌人的手，使他们四境获得了安宁。

text_en: Many brought gifts to the Lord in Jerusalem and precious things to King Hezekiah of Judah, so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from that time onward.
text_cn: 众人就都到耶路撒冷向上主献上礼品，也赠予犹大王希则克雅礼物；从此以后，希则克雅乃为各国所敬重。

text_en: In those days Hezekiah became sick and was at the point of death. He prayed to the Lord , and he answered him and gave him a sign.
text_cn: 那时，希则克雅害病要死，他哀求了上主，上主便应允了他，给了他一个异兆。

text_en: But Hezekiah did not respond according to the benefit done to him, for his heart was proud. Therefore wrath came upon him and upon Judah and Jerusalem.
text_cn: 但是，希则克雅不但没有照他所受的恩惠还报，反而心高气傲，于是上主的怒火降于他和犹大并耶路撒冷。

text_en: Then Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the Lord did not come upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
text_cn: 以后，希则克雅抑制了自己的骄傲，他和耶路撒冷居民都自谦自卑，因此上主的怒气，在希则克雅生时，没有向他们发作。

text_en: Hezekiah had very great riches and honor; and he made for himself treasuries for silver, for gold, for precious stones, for spices, for shields, and for all kinds of costly objects;
text_cn: 希则克雅享尽富贵荣华，建造了府库，储藏金银、宝石、香料、盾牌和各种珍器；

text_en: storehouses also for the yield of grain, wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of cattle, and sheepfolds.
text_cn: 修建了仓廪，储藏五谷、新酒和油；修盖了棚栏，为养各类牲畜；为羊群修了羊栈；

text_en: He likewise provided cities for himself, and flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him very great possessions.
text_cn: 又畜养了驴，以及许多大小牲畜；天主实在赐给了他极多的财物。

text_en: This same Hezekiah closed the upper outlet of the waters of Gihon and directed them down to the west side of the city of David. Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
text_cn: 希则克雅堵住基红泉上边的水，将水直引到达味城西。希则克雅所作所为无不顺利。

text_en: So also in the matter of the envoys of the officials of Babylon, who had been sent to him to inquire about the sign that had been done in the land, God left him to himself, in order to test him and to know all that was in his heart.
text_cn: 甚至巴比伦王公大人派使者来见希则克雅，询问他国内发生的奇事时，天主也让他自由，藉以考验他，好知道他心中的一切。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his good deeds, are written in the vision of the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
text_cn: 希则克雅其余的事迹，以及他的善行，都记载在阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚先知的《神视录》及《犹大和以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: Hezekiah slept with his ancestors, and they buried him on the ascent to the tombs of the descendants of David; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honor at his death. His son Manasseh succeeded him.
text_cn: 希则克雅与他的祖先同眠，葬在达味子孙墓地的斜坡上；他死了，全犹大和耶路撒冷居民都为他举哀致敬；他的儿子默纳舍继位为王。
